run.name: CI Build
run.display_title: Reuse CI compiler caches and preserve qualified analysis execution

head_commit.message:
Fix hosted CI cache activation and harden acceptance evidence

Introduced by: PR #80 cache/observation work exposed host-environment gaps;
the shell-dependent legacy logcat normalization fixture predates this PR.
Use case: Passing builds must actually exercise cache reuse, and validation
must distinguish incomplete evidence and fixture timing from correct behavior.

The first PR run inherited a real GITHUB_SHA into a synthetic observation
fixture, while native Windows uppercased VS/SDK environment names before a
case-sensitive dictionary lookup. Local fixtures did not model those inputs.
Isolate observation identities and normalize Windows lookup keys without
changing serialized identities, required fields or configuration isolation.

Restore Linux's established mtime compiler-check policy inside unchanged,
digest-qualified images. A real seeded-cache test proves that the content
policy transition alone invalidates objects; restore-only PRs could not replace
those shared seeds. Keep content checking for native macOS runner variation.

Make the legacy-error unit fixture deterministic through the existing process
seam, retain real stderr-file/notification behavior and real-child smoke, and
require observed completion with useful diagnostics. The precise old CI startup
error was not recorded; this is not claimed as a production sanitizer fix.

Reject malformed/incomplete performance evidence, exercise the consumer's real
receipt bindings, and hard-disable destructive cache cleanup until the missing
approval environment is configured and a reviewed activation removes the
interlock. Preserve the failed first PR run's actual metrics without relabeling
it as warm or successful acceptance evidence.

Verification: targeted observation, ccache, Windows cache, report, cleanup and
lock suites passed. Exact modified transport tests passed on Intel Xcode 26.6,
Qt 5.15.18 and Qt 6.9.3 with ASan+UBSan and QT_NO_KEYWORDS (44 assertions each).
Real cache invalidation and hostile Actions-environment regressions went from
RED to GREEN. Full batched quality validation will run before push; hosted
activation/warm acceptance still requires the next CI run.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
